meta.title.en: Department of Applied Mathematics — Hong-Ruei Wu

meta.description.zh: 吳弘叡在應用數學系兩年的活動紀錄，包含大數盃、系聚會與校運會。
meta.description.en: A record of Hong-Ruei Wu's two years of activities in the Department of Applied Mathematics, including the Big Math Cup, department gatherings, and sports day.

life-at-the-department-2.en: Life at the Department of Applied Mathematics

a-record-of-my.zh: 大學前兩年在應數系留下的紀錄。
a-record-of-my.en: A record of my first two years in the Department of Applied Mathematics.

alt.commemorative-photo-for-winning.zh: 校運會進場策畫獲得最佳驚喜獎的紀念照
alt.commemorative-photo-for-winning.en: Commemorative photo for winning the Best Surprise Award at the sports day entrance

as-the-planner-won.zh:
作為策畫，校運會進場獲得
「最佳驚喜獎」。

可惜沒有影片了
as-the-planner-won.en:
As the planner, won the "Best Surprise Award" at the sports day entrance.

Unfortunately, there is no video left.

alt.group-photo-at-the.zh: 應數系冬至湯圓聚會的合照
alt.group-photo-at-the.en: Group photo at the Department of Applied Mathematics' Winter Solstice tangyuan gathering

the-tangyuan-gathering-held.zh: 應數系每年冬至的湯圓聚會，有鹹有甜，大家都會抽空前來聊天吃湯圓。
the-tangyuan-gathering-held.en: The Tangyuan gathering held by the Department of Applied Mathematics every Winter Solstice. Both sweet and savory tangyuan are available, and everyone takes time to chat and eat.

alt.competing-in-the-2024.en: Competing in the 2024 Big Math Cup

2024-big-math-cup.zh: 2024大數盃，這次作為副隊長出賽，主打欄中，可惜那輪對手是本次的亞軍、季軍。
2024-big-math-cup.en: 2024 Big Math Cup, participated as vice-captain, mainly playing defense, but unfortunately faced the runner-up and third-place teams in this round.

alt.group-photo-with-graduating.zh: 與畢業的碩士班學長合照
alt.group-photo-with-graduating.en: Group photo with graduating master's students

the-second-year-master.zh: 碩二學長畢業了，與他們合照，現在當排球隊隊長需要一直諮詢他們。
the-second-year-master.en: The second-year master's seniors have graduated. I took a picture with them. Now, as the captain of the volleyball team, I often consult with them.
